title: On the Entanglement Entropy Distribution of a Hybrid Quantum Circuit
summary: We investigate the distribution of entanglement entropy in hybrid quantum circuits consisting of random unitary gates and local measurements applied at a finite rate. We demonstrate that higher moments of the entanglement entropy distribution, such as the ratio between the variance and the mean and the skewness, capture nontrivial features of the measurement-induced dynamics that are invisible to the mean entropy alone.
